src: unique bottom-row foreground source pixel; all other foreground pixels are fixed blockers
path: diagonal upward-right row sweep: the first two-cell band starts at the source column, each next row normally shifts one column right, and any blocker hit shifts the band further right until clear; stop after the band passes the right edge
trajectory: paint source color on the band cells, clipped by the right edge; when an extra right shift creates a gap, fill that gap on the previous row
transform: preserve the source pixel and all blocker pixels
